items.text: Beacon defines a governed QA evo-deep output contract with source refs, finding type, risk, affected ACs, route recommendation, blocked admissions, and release supplement input.
QA evo-deep records prior QA round memory as advisory influence only and never counts it as current pass evidence.
QA evo-deep supports state-machine, business-flow, scenario-combination, permission-boundary, data-source-consistency, cross-surface-closure, and repeated-failure finding families.
QA evo-deep detailed output writes to `docs/beacon/<version>/qa/evo-deep/<feature>.md`; research stores only index or design-input summaries.
Skill Eval Kit defines auditable cases with id, prompt, expected route, boundary expectations, source anchors, tags, split, expected evidence, and scoring dimensions.
Skill Eval Kit defines optimization and holdout splits plus a small regression core that can be run before skill or harness release.
Skill Eval Kit run outputs are runtime or machine evidence only and do not become requirement truth.
Skill Eval Kit includes route-stability cases for ordinary support skills, `beacon-deep`, `beacon-learn`, and `beacon-implement --mode single
Requirement clarity or release readiness fails closed if QA evo-deep or Skill Eval output claims PRD, user-story, test-case, QA verdict, release verdict, or freeze authority.
Implement current frozen revision

Verify AC-002 — QA evo-deep records prior QA round memory as advisory influence only and never counts it as current pass evidence.
Verify AC-003 — QA evo-deep supports state-machine, business-flow, scenario-combination, permission-boundary, data-source-consistency, cross-surface-closure, and repeated-failure finding families.
Verify AC-004 — QA evo-deep detailed output writes to `docs/beacon/<version>/qa/evo-deep/<feature>.md`; research stores only index or design-input summaries.
Verify AC-005 — Skill Eval Kit defines auditable cases with id, prompt, expected route, boundary expectations, source anchors, tags, split, expected evidence, and scoring dimensions.
Verify AC-006 — Skill Eval Kit defines optimization and holdout splits plus a small regression core that can be run before skill or harness release.
Verify AC-007 — Skill Eval Kit run outputs are runtime or machine evidence only and do not become requirement truth.
Verify AC-008 — Skill Eval Kit includes route-stability cases for ordinary support skills, `beacon-deep`, `beacon-learn`, and `beacon-implement --mode single
Verify AC-009 — Requirement clarity or release readiness fails closed if QA evo-deep or Skill Eval output claims PRD, user-story, test-case, QA verdict, release verdict, or freeze authority.

decision_priority: Markdown requirement truth wins over QA deep output and skill eval evidence.
QA evo-deep produces routeable findings, not release pass verdicts.
QA round memory is advisory influence and must be separated from current evidence.
Skill Eval Kit governs skill/harness quality, not product requirement truth.
Regression core failures block skill/harness release readiness, not unrelated requirement truth.
P1/P2 research inputs cannot silently expand the v1.4.10 P0 scope.
